QA Engineer I
Beacon Software

You will be the second QA engineer on a team of fourteen. Expect to spend your
time roughly half on manual exploratory testing and half on automation.

What you will do
- Write and execute test plans for new features
- Build and maintain automated end-to-end tests
- File clear, reproducible bug reports
- Work with developers to reproduce and diagnose production issues
- Own release sign-off for your product area

Required skills
- Understanding of software testing fundamentals and test design techniques
- Ability to write clear reproduction steps
- Basic programming ability in Python, Java or JavaScript
- Familiarity with SQL for verifying data
- Experience with a bug tracking tool such as Jira

Nice to have
- Selenium, Cypress or Playwright
- API testing with Postman or similar
- Exposure to CI pipelines
- ISTQB certification
